decisions.reason: As a 2023 line extension that remained on the website in 2024 and fits the firm's established laser-marking capabilities, it likely stays above a tolerable aspiration level and benefits from the firm's slack.
Its dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests acceptable early market traction for a close-to-core printer, so management would likely retain it rather than reallocate resources.
The product kept its own page across both years and broadens the firm's inkjet offer within familiar technology, making discontinuation unlikely unless results clearly fall below aspiration.
Because it was launched in 2024 as a flagship line and shown on the home page, it is strongly aligned with the firm's strategic direction and would almost certainly be kept.
This newly launched laser cabin has its own page and supports the firm's core marking portfolio, so a large incumbent would usually give it more time before considering withdrawal.

Its narrower application and lower website prominence make it the most vulnerable if demand disappoints, but its fit with the firm's printing know-how and the firm's organizational slack still favor keeping it for now.
